observations: Three photos show a used automotive gearbox lying on a concrete surface, surrounded by other engines and mechanical parts.
The gearbox has a long, rectangular metal casing with visible wear, dirt, and grime, especially on the front and sides.
There are numerous hoses, wires, and connectors attached to the gearbox, some of which are blue and black.
The front end of the gearbox has a protruding shaft or output end, typical of a transmission or gearbox assembly.
The background in all photos shows a workshop or salvage yard environment with other engines and parts.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the gearbox in any photo.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.' is overlaid on all photos.
